title: Frukt Cyder Mixed Berries 100ml E-liquid
description: This gently sparkling mixed fruit blend from the Frukt Cider series is a sweet, crisp vape dancing with the taste of ripe strawberries, blueberries, blackberries and tangy raspberries. These luscious fruits sit against a bubbly backdrop of effervescent fizz, making for a revitalising exhale which wakes up the taste buds and transports you to a sun-drenched pub garden with an icy pint of apple cider cooling your palm!
